messages:
rachel: FYI canary in us-west is showing tail latency spikes after chart bump. 95p latency doubled. deploy-bot raised a latency regression alert at 14:07 UTC.

ben: I merged the chart bump (gh:PR#6789) which enabled `sessionAffinity.cookie: true` and bumped sidecar to v1.9. The values change was intended for sticky routing for experiments.

tony: sticky sessions can concentrate traffic on a subset of pods if the session cookie lands on older instances. Did we also change the HPA or affinity?

ben: only cookie=true and sidecar image. HPA unchanged.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2025-07-12T14:05:10Z by ben/gh:PR#6789. Canary fraction 5% -> 30%. Observed metrics: 95p latency +120%, pod CPU skew (some pods at 90%), 429 spikes on a single node.

qa-bot: quick smoke tests failed: /health ok but end-to-end session test shows degraded throughput.

rachel: options: (A) rollback entire chart (loses several small telemetry fixes in same release), (B) hotpatch to disable sessionAffinity cookie flag (quick), (C) pin to previous chart version and reapply telemetry fixes separately.

tony: hotpatch seems least disruptive. also request a short pause on auto-rollback so we can push patch.

deploy-bot: Pausing auto-rollback for deploy 2025-07-12T14:05:10Z for 10 minutes per request from tony. Notifying #eng-oncall.

ben: opened PR #6792 to set `sessionAffinity.cookie: false` in values and add a note. CI running. ETA ~6m.

rachel: when CI green, apply patch with controlled restart: ```kubectl -n frontend set env deploy/frontend SERVICE_SESSION_AFFINITY=false && kubectl -n frontend rollout status deploy/frontend -w```

qa-bot: PR #6792 CI passed. Merging.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied at 14:18 UTC. New pods coming up with cookie disabled. Canary fraction pinned at 5% for 5m to observe.

rachel: metrics: 95p latency returning to baseline within 3m, CPU skew resolved. Looks green.

tony: ok to unpause rollback? also add a release-note entry and a follow-up ticket to add a preflight that flags sessionAffinity toggles without a documented load-test.

deploy-bot: Resuming auto-rollback and clearing pause for deploy 2025-07-12T14:05:10Z.

ben: adding to release notes: "Reverted accidental `sessionAffinity.cookie` enablement in frontend chart due to observed canary latency spikes; telemetry fixes retained via follow-up PRs." Also creating TICKET-332 to add helm-lint rule for affinity toggles + update release notes template to call out stateful-affinity changes that require a change window.

rachel: add a changelog line and add a short how-to for QA on rolling session-affinity changes. :memo:
